TIL That Watching TV Puts Your Brain Into A State Similar To Sleeping
I was under the impression that TIL should be full of facts.
There is a plethora of information on how TV affects the brain: The Effects Of TV On The Brain

I have read the Cracked article, years ago. I'm not saying that there aren't grains of truth in this article, it's just full of sketchy citations, and is completely negative. It's important not to confuse correlation and causation. Also, in the age of the internet how does this translate to being glues to a computer or phone screen? I'm sure more reading is involved, but when accosted with so many poorly written articles that has to have quite a few negative impacts on the brain.

Yes, the correlation and causation question is always a factor. I've wondered if people who watch excessive TV have poor physical health which may be as big of a factor in brain function as just the visual effects of TV viewing.
